# design-direction

`design-direction` is a portable design skill for AI coding agents.

Canonical instructions:
- skill.md

Installable Codex entrypoint:
- SKILL.md

Task prompts:
- prompts/design-direction.md
- prompts/design-review.md
- prompts/break-ui.md
- prompts/mobile-native.md
- prompts/motion.md

Reference library:
- references/inspiration-sources.md
- references/component-sources.md
- references/design-heuristics.md
- references/motion-principles.md
- references/mobile-native.md
- references/qa-checklist.md

Contribution workflow:
- CONTRIBUTING.md
- GOVERNANCE.md
- .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/add-reference.md
- .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/correction.md

Use the skill for product UI design, implementation guidance, design critique, motion decisions, mobile web polish, component-library selection, and UI stress testing.
